title: A monodromy relation for the Cartwright-Steger fibration
summary: We study the genus-$19$ Albanese fibration of the Cartwright--Steger surface and its order-three symmetry. Passing to the orbifold quotient of the elliptic base gives a relation among the two handle monodromies and the three Dehn twists about the vanishing cycles. The two real vanishing paths give cycles whose real fixed points lie on different ovals of the invariant fiber. For a cyclic triple cover, we express the intersection of a curve with its image under the deck transformation as a signed crossing count on the quotient.
